item.title: How To Write Email Readers Actually Want To Open
item.description: Markus writes: Greetings from Germany. I subscribed to learn more about how to write an engaging and personal newsletter. I loved the tone in your book Everybody Writes and want to learn how to find and add my own voice to everything I write (newsletters, blog articles, YouTube scripts).

item.title: Don't Outsource This Part Of Writing
item.description: *** Trigger warning: This piece contains a graphic description of animal death. *** I wasn’t going to write about AI this week because I’m tired of thinking about it. Plus I’m feeling better and it’s late summer in New England and I want to be in this low-humidity-beautiful world and not feel both existential and actual dread.

item.title: Is The Age Of Reading Actually Over?
item.description: I’m at the gym, where the conversation turns to what everyone is reading this summer. Normally conversation there is fragmented (kids, work schedules, how loud our thigh muscles are screaming from Bulgarian split squats).

item.title: The Brainy Little Sales Pitch Behind Every Choice You Make
item.description: Why we buy, save, snack, scroll, splurge, procrastinate, and occasionally convince ourselves that a 40-pack of pens is a “smart investment.” Imagine this: You walk into a store for one item—say, toothpaste.

item.title: Blogging Research Data
item.description: Here I am back with the data. Which is (I’m sorry to say) not very comforting. In fact, it’s an actual wake-up call. And not the whispered hey-sweet-pea time-to-get-up gentle nudge. But more a bugle to your eardrum type.

item.title: Why Care About The Em Dash?

item.description: This week I was at the National Agri-Marketing Association in St. Louis, Missouri, where I gave a brand-new speech on how we prove the power of a slower, lasting marketing move.

item.title: How To Secure More Speaking Gigs
item.description: This week I’ve been obsessed with Jimothy, the short-spined raccoon that the entire internet is rooting for. I also stopped eating salad unless it comes from my local farmer’s market. Bonus: I discovered there is a local farmer’s market.

item.title: Where I've Been — New Book!
item.description: My left eyelid has been twitching for the past month or so. It’s a quick, intermittent fluttering, like my eyelid is trying to send me distress signals in Morse code.
